_readme: Hand-labelled calibration probe set for the arch-memory band thresholds.
Plan: docs/plans/arch-memory-band-recalibration.md §7c.
Identity is (filePath, symbolName) — NOT the symbol_index UUID, which is
re-minted by every arch:refresh and would rot this fixture on first re-index.
relation:
reuse  — a genuine duplicate exists; the consultation SHOULD say reuse.
extend — a close symbol exists that should be extended rather than forked.
none   — HARD NEGATIVE: no appropriate existing symbol. Correct answer is
`review`. These are load-bearing: with a 0.5440 noise floor, a
threshold chosen only on positives will happily fire on garbage.
Every symbol below was verified present in the active index snapshot on
2026-07-19. Intents are phrased the way a developer actually phrases them —
that genre asymmetry is precisely what is being measured.
POST-HOC ALTERNATES (2026-07-20) — provenance disclosure:
The first calibration run scored recall@5 = 0.5714 (9 of 21 positives
missed). Inspection showed most misses were THIS FIXTURE being
under-specified, not the retrieval failing: the repo genuinely contains
several equally-correct answers for many intents, and only one probe
originally declared `alternates`.
Probes carrying `alternatesAddedPostHoc: true` had alternates added AFTER
seeing a failing run. That is fixture-fitting risk, so the rule applied was:
an alternate was added ONLY if reading the symbol's source showed it
genuinely answers the intent — never merely because it was returned. Each
added symbol was read before inclusion. Two probes were deliberately left
UNCHANGED as genuine retrieval failures (reuse-compose-index-text and
extend-ledger-severity-adjust) because nothing returned was an acceptable
answer. One probe (extend-path-classification-symlinks) had its `expected`
CORRECTED: `resolveAndClassify` is the actual symlink-resolving layer, so
the original expectation was wrong, not the retrieval.
Anyone re-deriving thresholds should treat post-hoc probes as weaker
evidence than the untouched ones.

probes.intent: add a function that finds similar existing symbols before I write new code
I need to turn a string into an embedding vector using the configured provider
write a file safely so a crash mid-write can't corrupt it
probes._note: The repo has FOUR temp-file+rename implementations. All genuinely answer the intent, so all count. That this probe 'failed' is itself the arch-memory feature working as designed — these are exactly the near-duplicates a working consultation should surface.

probes.intent: check whether a user-supplied git revision string is safe to pass to git
work out whether a file path is a secret or credential file
probes._note: AGENTS.md names sensitive-paths.mjs the single source of truth and these as its delegating consumers. Each is a real public predicate answering the intent.

probes.intent: block a payload from being sent to an external API if it contains secrets
map a cosine similarity score onto a recommendation band
rank candidate symbols by how close they are to what I'm working on
turn a model sentinel like latest-gpt into a concrete model id
record an adjudication decision about a finding to the ledger
probes._note: Both are genuine ledger writers. `recordAdjudicationEvent` was deliberately NOT added despite ranking 2nd — it writes to the DB store, and this intent says 'to the ledger'. Excluding a plausible-but-wrong candidate is the discipline that keeps post-hoc labelling honest.

probes.intent: stop the audit re-raising findings that were already dismissed
generate a stable content-based id so the same finding matches across rounds
compute the reward signal for a bandit arm from how a finding resolved
build the text that represents a symbol for embedding
probes._note: LEFT UNCHANGED — genuine retrieval failure. Top-5 returned cmdRecordSymbolDefinitions, PROMPT_TEMPLATE, cmdRecordSymbolEmbedding, redactText, main (0.658-0.670); none builds a symbol's embedding text. `compose` is a 6-line function with a terse summary, crowded out by bulkier neighbours — independent evidence for pulling the compose() template fix into Phase 3.

probes.intent: strip API keys and passwords out of text before logging it
add batching with a concurrency limit to the embedding calls
probes._note: Verified by reading: embedBatch already IS the batch-embedding wrapper, so it is arguably a better answer to this intent than embedText. Original expectation was defensible but not exclusive.

probes.intent: let the symbol consultation filter results down to just hooks and components
probes._note: cmdGetNeighbourhood is the CLI entry point for exactly this consultation and is where a `kind` filter would surface to a caller.

probes.intent: support downgrading a finding's severity instead of only accept or dismiss
probes._note: LEFT UNCHANGED — genuine retrieval failure. Top-5 returned isSeverityUnderstated, classifyStage1Outcome, applyStage1MechanicalEarlyFilter, classifyDeferralEvidence and a test fixture (0.636-0.671); none is where severity adjustment would be implemented. The ledger's two-axis outcome model (adjudicationOutcome incl. severity_adjusted) lives in writeLedgerEntry.

probes.intent: make sensitive path detection follow symlinks to their real target
probes._note: EXPECTATION CORRECTED, not merely widened. Read of sensitive-paths.mjs:214 confirms resolveAndClassify IS the symlink-resolving layer over classifyPath (realpath + repoRoot containment, fail-closed). The retrieval was RIGHT and my original expectation was wrong — recorded explicitly because 'the tool was correct and the fixture was not' is the kind of result a calibration set must be able to represent.

probes.intent: teach the model resolver about a new provider tier sentinel
probes._note: All three are the tier/sentinel machinery in the same module; adding a new tier sentinel touches them directly. Retrieval put the whole correct neighbourhood in the top 3.

probes.intent: add an fsync option to the atomic file writer for durability
recommend a wine pairing for a given dish based on tannin and acidity
generate a PDF invoice with line items and VAT for a customer order
track which users are currently online using a websocket presence channel
resize an uploaded image into three thumbnail sizes and strip EXIF data
verify a Stripe webhook signature and record the payment
expand a recurring calendar event rule into concrete occurrences
calculate the great-circle distance between two latitude longitude points
apply a percentage discount code to a shopping cart subtotal
suggest spelling corrections for a mistyped search term using edit distance
render an audio waveform visualisation from a raw PCM buffer
compute income tax owed across progressive tax brackets
